subtitle: Faster, with tools that do more
- Faster start
- AI chat tools
- School events
- Chemistry, typeset
---
**This update is about getting there sooner and doing more once you are.** Edupage2 opens straight into its cached content, the timetable finally shows school events next to lessons, and the AI chat can now read the web and your files — and typeset a reaction when you ask for one.

### A faster start
- **No loading screen for signed-in users:** the app opens on your cached overview and restores the session behind it.
- **Less work before the first frame:** session checks, cache warm-up and the settings graph no longer run on the way to the first screen.
- **A generated Baseline Profile:** the startup path is compiled ahead of time on install.

### AI chat, with tools
- **Web, image and document tools:** ask the assistant to look something up, read an attachment or work from a picture.
- **Chemistry, typeset:** reactions and structures are drawn properly instead of being spelled out in plain text.
- **A steadier reply:** the typewriter reveal keeps pace as the answer streams in, and quiz results group their actions under the explanations.

### Timetable and overview
- **School events:** trips, holidays and events appear on the timetable and in the overview, replacing empty rows as one continuous section instead of leaving gaps.
- **Cleaner pictures:** image titles stay lined up with the pictures that actually loaded.
